paragraphs.text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we faint not:
paragraphs.original: Διὰ τοῦτο, ἔχοντες τὴν διακονίαν ταύτην καθὼς ἠλεήθημεν, οὐκ ἐγκακοῦμεν,
paragraphs.translit: Dia touto, echontes tēn diakonian tautēn kathōs ēleēthēmen, ouk enkakoumen,

paragraphs.text: but we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man`s conscience in the sight of God.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ἀπειπάμεθα τὰ κρυπτὰ τῆς αἰσχύνης, μὴ περιπατοῦντες ἐν πανουργίᾳ μηδὲ δολοῦντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀλλὰ τῇ φανερώσει τῆς ἀληθείας συνιστάνοντες ἑαυτοὺς πρὸς πᾶσαν συνείδησιν ἀνθρώπων ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: alla apeipametha ta krypta tēs aischynēs, mē peripatountes en panourgia mēde dolountes ton logon tou theou, alla tē phanerōsei tēs alētheias synistanontes heautous pros pasan syneidēsin anthrōpōn enōpion tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled in them that perish:
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ καὶ ἔστιν κεκαλυμμένον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν, ἐν τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις ἐστὶν κεκαλυμμένον,
paragraphs.translit: ei de kai estin kekalymmenon to euangelion hēmōn, en tois apollymenois estin kekalymmenon,

paragraphs.text: in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn [upon them].
paragraphs.original: ἐν οἷς ὁ θεὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἐτύφλωσεν τὰ νοήματα τῶν ἀπίστων εἰς τὸ μὴ αὐγάσαι τὸν φωτισμὸν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς δόξης τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: en hois ho theos tou aiōnos toutou etyphlōsen ta noēmata tōn apistōn eis to mē augasai ton phōtismon tou euangeliou tēs doxēs tou Christou, hos estin eikōn tou theou.

paragraphs.text: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus` sake.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἑαυτοὺς κηρύσσομεν ἀλλὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν κύριον, ἑαυτοὺς δὲ δούλους ὑμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦν.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar heautous kēryssomen alla Christon Iēsoun kyrion, heautous de doulous hymōn dia Iēsoun.

paragraphs.text: Seeing it is God, that said, Light shall shine out of darkness, who shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ὁ εἰπών· Ἐκ σκότους φῶς λάμψει, ὃς ἔλαμψεν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν πρὸς φωτισμὸν τῆς γνώσεως τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν προσώπῳ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hoti ho theos ho eipōn· Ek skotous phōs lampsei, hos elampsen en tais kardiais hēmōn pros phōtismon tēs gnōseōs tēs doxēs tou theou en prosōpō Christou.

paragraphs.text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves;
paragraphs.original: Ἔχομεν δὲ τὸν θησαυρὸν τοῦτον ἐν ὀστρακίνοις σκεύεσιν, ἵνα ἡ ὑπερβολὴ τῆς δυνάμεως ᾖ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ μὴ ἐξ ἡμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Echomen de ton thēsauron touton en ostrakinois skeuesin, hina hē hyperbolē tēs dynameōs ē tou theou kai mē ex hēmōn·

paragraphs.text: [we are] pressed on every side, yet not straitened; perplexed, yet not unto despair;
paragraphs.original: ἐν παντὶ θλιβόμενοι ἀλλʼ οὐ στενοχωρούμενοι, ἀπορούμενοι ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐξαπορούμενοι,
paragraphs.translit: en panti thlibomenoi allʼ ou stenochōroumenoi, aporoumenoi allʼ ouk exaporoumenoi,

paragraphs.text: pursued, yet not forsaken; smitten down, yet not destroyed;
paragraphs.original: διωκόμενοι ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐγκαταλειπόμενοι, καταβαλλόμενοι ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἀπολλύμενοι,
paragraphs.translit: diōkomenoi allʼ ouk enkataleipomenoi, kataballomenoi allʼ ouk apollymenoi,

paragraphs.text: always bearing about in the body the dying of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our body.
paragraphs.original: πάντοτε τὴν νέκρωσιν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματι περιφέροντες, ἵνα καὶ ἡ ζωὴ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματι ἡμῶν φανερωθῇ·
paragraphs.translit: pantote tēn nekrōsin tou Iēsou en tō sōmati peripherontes, hina kai hē zōē tou Iēsou en tō sōmati hēmōn phanerōthē·

paragraphs.text: For we who live are always delivered unto death for Jesus` sake, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
paragraphs.original: ἀεὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες εἰς θάνατον παραδιδόμεθα διὰ Ἰησοῦν, ἵνα καὶ ἡ ζωὴ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ φανερωθῇ ἐν τῇ θνητῇ σαρκὶ ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: aei gar hēmeis hoi zōntes eis thanaton paradidometha dia Iēsoun, hina kai hē zōē tou Iēsou phanerōthē en tē thnētē sarki hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε ὁ θάνατος ἐν ἡμῖν ἐνεργεῖται, ἡ δὲ ζωὴ ἐν ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: hōste ho thanatos en hēmin energeitai, hē de zōē en hymin.

paragraphs.text: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, I believed, and therefore did I speak; we also believe, and therefore also we speak;
paragraphs.original: Ἔχοντες δὲ τὸ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πίστεως, κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον· Ἐπίστευσα, διὸ ἐλάλησα, καὶ ἡμεῖς πιστεύομεν, διὸ καὶ λαλοῦμεν,
paragraphs.translit: Echontes de to auto pneuma tēs pisteōs, kata to gegrammenon· Episteusa, dio elalēsa, kai hēmeis pisteuomen, dio kai laloumen,

paragraphs.text: knowing that he that raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also with Jesus, and shall present us with you.
paragraphs.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ ἐγείρας τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἡμᾶς σὺν Ἰησοῦ ἐγερεῖ καὶ παραστήσει σὺν ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: eidotes hoti ho egeiras ton Iēsoun kai hēmas syn Iēsou egerei kai parastēsei syn hymin.

paragraphs.text: For all things [are] for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound unto the glory of God.
paragraphs.original: τὰ γὰρ πάντα διʼ ὑμᾶς, ἵνα ἡ χάρις πλεονάσασα διὰ τῶν πλειόνων τὴν εὐχαριστίαν περισσεύσῃ εἰς τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ta gar panta diʼ hymas, hina hē charis pleonasasa dia tōn pleionōn tēn eucharistian perisseusē eis tēn doxan tou theou.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore we faint not; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
paragraphs.original: Διὸ οὐκ ἐγκακοῦμεν, ἀλλʼ εἰ καὶ ὁ ἔξω ἡμῶν ἄνθρωπος διαφθείρεται, ἀλλʼ ὁ ἔσω ἡμῶν ἀνακαινοῦται ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἡμέρᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: Dio ouk enkakoumen, allʼ ei kai ho exō hēmōn anthrōpos diaphtheiretai, allʼ ho esō hēmōn anakainoutai hēmera kai hēmera.

paragraphs.text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, worketh for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;
paragraphs.original: τὸ γὰρ παραυτίκα ἐλαφρὸν τῆς θλίψεως ἡμῶν καθʼ ὑπερβολὴν εἰς ὑπερβολὴν αἰώνιον βάρος δόξης κατεργάζεται ἡμῖν,
paragraphs.translit: to gar parautika elaphron tēs thlipseōs hēmōn kathʼ hyperbolēn eis hyperbolēn aiōnion baros doxēs katergazetai hēmin,

paragraphs.text: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
paragraphs.original: μὴ σκοπούντων ἡμῶν τὰ βλεπόμενα ἀλλὰ τὰ μὴ βλεπόμενα, τὰ γὰρ βλεπόμενα πρόσκαιρα, τὰ δὲ μὴ βλεπόμενα αἰώνια.
paragraphs.translit: mē skopountōn hēmōn ta blepomena alla ta mē blepomena, ta gar blepomena proskaira, ta de mē blepomena aiōnia.
